Practise in the game

Courier's Atlas is a puzzle game where you play a courier. Each region matches a subject: Packet Valley goes with Networks, and Algo Archipelago goes with Algorithms, and Ledger Library goes with Databases, and Blueprint Borough goes with Java, and Vault Harbour goes with Advanced Databases, and Learning Fields goes with Machine Learning, and Wordwood goes with Natural Language Processing, and Waypoint Woods goes with AI Planning. More levels will be added.

Play Courier's Atlas in your browser
